## What it does

Takes a BibTeX export, the kind you download from Scopus, Web of Science, or Zotero after a literature search and converts it into a clean, structured Microsoft Word document. Every article gets its own entry: the title, a formatted reference, and the full abstract (Must be selected in the export).

## Why I built it

A professor wanted me to collect the abstracts of a hundred papers (turns out she was exaggerating and just wanted 20). 

## Status

::: {.callout-tip appearance="simple"}
**Working prototype.** Not maintained. Fork it rather than depend on it.
:::
